definitions.explanation: The sun as it rises in the early morning. Refers both to the physical sun visible at dawn and to the light it casts. A word with poetic and cultural resonance in Japanese, evoking freshness, new beginnings, and the beauty of dawn.

examples.japanese: {朝日|あさひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まぶしい→まぶしい：03737_mabushii⟧。
{朝日|あさひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びて→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: I take a walk bathed in the morning sun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}こう⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{朝日|あさひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{昇|のぼ}って→昇る：12960_noboru⟧きた。
examples.english: The morning sun rose from beyond the mountains.

examples.japanese: {朝日|あさひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}らされた→照らす：04669_terasu⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{金色|きんいろ}→金色：05067_kiniro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いていた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: The sea, lit up by the morning sun, was shining gold.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ (morning) and ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (sun/day), with the voicing change ひ→び. The word refers specifically to the sun at dawn — not just any morning sunlight, but the sun itself as it appears on the horizon.

The word carries strong aesthetic and cultural associations. It appears in the name of {旭日旗|きょくじつき} (Rising Sun flag), the newspaper {朝日新聞|あさひしんぶん}, and the beer brand アサヒ. It is also a common element in place names and personal names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝日|あさひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{昇|のぼ}る→昇る：12960_noboru⟧: the morning sun rises
- {朝日|あさひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧: to bathe in the morning sun
- {朝日|あさひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}らされる→照らす：04669_terasu⟧: to be illuminated by the morning sun
- {朝日|あさひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧: morning sunlight streams in

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夕日|ゆうひ}→夕日：04080_yuuhi⟧: evening sun, sunset — the counterpart at the other end of the day
- ⟦{日|ひ}の{出|で}→日の出：17596_hinode⟧: sunrise — refers to the event/moment of sunrise rather than the sun itself
- {旭日|きょくじつ}: rising sun — a more literary/formal synonym, used in compounds like {旭日旗|きょくじつき}
